title: Threshold Conatus — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Threshold Conatus's rich face: one walk the Shop made for the section on the threshold's own conatus, building a threshold one mechanism at a time and ending on the test of whether a graduated recovery makes it choose, with the fingerprint of the words it was made against. The page's other sections are claims of a kind a model can't test, so they stay as text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
grain: The page's own ## grain. One section made; the rest are synthesis and dialogue claims (self-models, the trickster, homecoming or becoming) that no piece can test without claiming Loudon's reading for him.

offers.what: 'During relative refractory, only suprathreshold stimuli recruit it' reads as a tautology, since any stimulus that fires is above the threshold of that moment. Proposed: 'only stimuli stronger than would fire it at rest recruit it, and the stronger, the sooner.' The piece shows that shape in a model: the weakest probe that crosses is 1.85x the resting threshold at 2.5 ms after a crossing, 1.37x at 5 ms, 1.07x at 10 ms, and none at any strength up to 1000x inside the first 2 ms. It also shows that the preference by strength belongs to the relative period alone; the absolute period alone is a gate, deciding by timing. 'Graduated' already says this, so no change is asked for that. The numbers are the model's (absolute 2 ms, below-rest depth equal to the threshold, recovery time constant 3 ms), not a neuron's.

proposed.by: maker · claude-opus-5-5 · proposal round · cloud batch 3

pieces.title: which stimuli does a threshold let through? · a walk in six steps
pieces.caption: **Does the graduated recovery make the threshold choose, and does the choosing go when the recovery goes?** A threshold, then two stimuli, then the absolute period, then the relative period, then one train through four versions. The test comes last: a stated train of 182 paired stimuli, scored in every version against a rule fixed before the run, with the controls that could make it fail. In this model it holds: the full recovery is graduated, and with the recovery removed the bar is flat. It also shows the two halves apart. The absolute period alone is a gate. The relative period alone chooses by strength but has no floor. What it cannot reach, it says: whether any of this is a conatus. Silent; the numbers are the model's, not a neuron's.

verdicts.why: A test of the section's structural claim in a model, honest that the result follows by construction; the four-arm split (absolute alone a gate, relative alone graded with no floor, both graduated) is a finding the text lacks, every bar recomputes cell for cell, it walks up, and it names its one-cause limit. Note only: step 4 calls the model's period "the section's graduated recovery" where the section means a neuron's.
